RUMBA.gloss: syncopated music in duple time for dancing the rumba
RUMBA.definition: Syncopated music in duple time for dancing the rumba.

UMBRA.gloss: a region of complete shadow resulting from total obstruction of light
UMBRA.definition: A region of complete shadow resulting from total obstruction of light.

BAR.gloss: a room or establishment where alcoholic drinks are served over a counter
BAR.definition: A room or establishment where alcoholic drinks are served over a counter.
BAR.example: He drowned his sorrows in whiskey at the bar.

ARM.definition: A human limb; technically the part of the superior limb between the shoulder and the elbow but commonly used to refer to the whole superior limb.

RAM.gloss: strike or drive against with a heavy impact
RAM.definition: Strike or drive against with a heavy impact.
RAM.example: Ram the gate with a sledgehammer.

BRA.definition: An undergarment worn by women to support their breasts.

BUM.gloss: a person who is deemed to be despicable or contemptible
BUM.definition: A person who is deemed to be despicable or contemptible.
BUM.example: Only a rotter would do that.
